surfaces.rationale: Coverage for bin/janitor's per-candidate report (agentic-hzr1): a dry run names every candidate worktree with its branch, owning issue and status, category, action, and a reason for each skip, and --json carries the same records as an array. It is a separate suite because the janitor-worktree-sweep fragment pins tests/test_janitor_worktree_sweep.sh as retain, freezing its bytes. Disposition is repair so this suite can grow with the report it covers.
